name: hs-rerank-1
purpose: Multilingual cross-encoder reranker built for the Hindsight memory system: reads query and document together and returns a relevance score (card).

license.name: MIT
license.notes: Card states MIT (header and license section); no LICENSE file opened.

architecture.kind: encoder cross-encoder (mmBERT-small), 114M parameters of which 98M are the token embedding table, so each pass runs a 15M-parameter transformer

variants.format: safetensors FP16 (FP32 on the fp32 branch) plus ONNX int8-vocabulary export

strengths: Very small and fast: a 15M-parameter transformer pass
German is one of the eight languages
weaknesses: Benchmarks only as an image in the card
Built for an agent-memory use case, general retrieval quality unmeasured by us
best_for: cheap CPU-side reranking in local memory or RAG pipelines
soft.maturity: 1.88M downloads on the HF API as of 2026-11-19 (the card documents it as a selectable local reranker model for Hindsight).

tona_fit.reason: Tiny, MIT, German-capable reranker that fits every class; relevant for local memory and RAG where Tona needs a CPU reranker. Needs our own German retrieval test since the card gives no numeric benchmark.
blockers: mmBERT encoder cross-encoder not in Tona
no numeric benchmark available as text

open_questions: Quality against bge-reranker-v2-m3 and qwen3-reranker-0.6b on German
